about_the_game:
The mystery doesn’t end where you left it. Dive deeper into the haunted past of the Montgomery family in the DLC for "Hidden Legacy: Dark Heirloom". This expansion brings four brand-new locations filled with hidden object scenes, intricate puzzles, and chilling revelations that will bring you closer than ever to the truth behind the family’s cursed heirloom.

Explore new corners of the Montgomery legacy — discover ancient secrets, follow the echoes of dark rituals, and uncover more of the story that binds generations in shadow. This time, knowledge isn’t just power — it’s survival.

👁️ Uncover More of the Family’s Dark Past!

Investigate the historical museum to find crucial artifacts and hidden stashes that reveal the origins of the family curse. Piece together long-lost documents and solve thematic mini-games to unlock disturbing truths about the Montgomery bloodline.

👁️ Unravel the Mysteries of Isabella’s Rituals!

Step into the ominous ritual room and study Isabella’s cryptic tools and symbols. What were her intentions? What did she try to summon or protect? Solve ceremonial puzzles and search for clues hidden in plain sight.

👁️ Track the Thief in the Scottish Cemetery!

At Glenna’s secluded hut, evidence of a break-in leads you on the trail of a mysterious thief. Sift through shattered memories, search for what was stolen, and gather clues to identify who might be behind this bold intrusion.

👁️ Investigate the Gorge and Its Hidden Symbols!

Among the jagged cliffs of the mountain gorge, strange markings emerge under ultraviolet light. Solve layered puzzles in a treacherous environment to decipher the cryptic messages etched into stone — they may hold the final keys to the mystery.

The heirloom’s curse is more insidious than you ever imagined. Are you ready to reveal the final truths?
